items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I'm trying to think of, Marcellus Marsalis Green - but he's passed on. Like most, a lot of the boys are gone.

ctx.x: When I got to 'Bama State, well,

then, that's, well, I met Haywood Henry, Sammy Lowe; Julian Dash I met in New York. He went to 'Bama State the year after we left; Big Jack Marshall, who was drums; Jimmy Mitchelle; I'm trying to think of, Marcellus Marsalis Green - but he's passed on. Like most, a lot of the boys are gone. Well, then there, let me see, Paul Bascomb which was Dud Bascomb's brother. He joined me in New York. I said Julian joined me in New York, too, because he went to 'Bama State the year after I left. Well, that's, J.B. Sims.

At the time I was sitting down in the band playing, knocking the numbers off and calling the tunes, I had him in front, directing. He was there. Well, I had contact with a lot of them when I got to 'Bama State.
